about: One SVM mini-domain shown as a taxonomy, an ontology (T-box) and a knowledge graph (A-box). The tree, the classes and the relation names are OUR modelling; the edges' evidence quotes are real and checked by build_lesson.py.

tree_limits.text: SVM is a classifier AND a kernel method, but in a tree each node has one parent, so here it sits under Classification only. (Z39.19 allows several parents, a polyhierarchy.)

Our tree records only broader/narrower placement, without saying which kind of hierarchy (kind-of, instance-of, part-of: Z39.19 Sec. 8.3 can say this; our tree does not). It cannot say that SVM uses a kernel function, or that the dot product comes first.
Linear separability is a property of data. Our tree has no branch for it (a bigger tree could add one, e.g. under classification theory).

shapes.text: Every A-box edge carries evidence (a passage, dataset file or lecture note).
Every Method that a lecture covers has at least one Passage that defines it.
prerequisite-of has no cycle (a learning order must exist).
No node is both a Concept and a Learning resource (or a Dataset).

lp.method: LP feasibility (scipy.optimize.linprog, HiGHS): exists w, b with y_i (w.x_i + b) >= 1 for all points, 4 features. Infeasible = not linearly separable.
